goal: Research the contracts already present in Akashic Records, identify the contract families that are missing or intentionally deferred, and produce an audited public-safe delta for the current Design.

selected_entries.summary: The prior audited result recommends Git-authored SourceRecord and ClaimRecord values plus generated Inventory and context-packet views, while preserving six blocker clusters and deferring richer epistemic records, graph substrates, and Olog.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Primary source lead for the existing contract boundaries, killed relations, owner gaps, and smallest witness.

selectors: source selector -> inventory evidence card / EvidenceSet -> ontology candidate -> PromotionRecord -> governed ontology node or projection -> generated read models
selected_entries.summary: Inventory should feed ontology through selected source-backed claims and explicit promotion records; Inventory rows and generated graphs remain non-authority read models.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Constrains the semantic and authority contract families so graph projection cannot mint identity, meaning, confidence, status, or promotion.

selected_entries.summary: The surviving requirement is a stable citable typed referent plus a recorded gate; deterministic retrieval is an optimization and reproducibility property, not an authority source.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Prevents the Design from overclaiming deterministic projection as truth or governance, while preserving version, digest, and parity contracts.

selected_entries.summary: Authority-bearing kinds require owner-gated lifecycle treatment; evidence and read models do not promote themselves.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Seeds the separation between contributor-authored values, conformance facts, assessments, owner decisions, and publication or promotion effects.

excluded_entries.reason: Useful as a general claim-boundary example, but it governs a separate reasoning-engine runtime and would broaden this research beyond the Akashic content, retrieval, and contribution contracts.
Its cross-graph validation routing is materially richer than the current Akashic Phase-0 slice; it remains a later comparison lead, not a Design source.
The selected authority-lifecycle invariant entry already supplies the narrower owner and promotion boundary needed here.

unresolved_gaps: No explicit catalogue currently states every contract family, its phase, producer, consumer, authority effect, version owner, diagnostic boundary, and witness.
The Design mentions schema, predicate, selector, generator, and projection versions but does not yet define a registry, compatibility matrix, deprecation rule, or migration admission contract.
Phase-1 issue, context-packet, add-content, review-content, owner-decision, merge, and post-merge rebuild contracts are named but not designed.
The division between validation facts, repository receipts, assessments, owner decisions, publication, and promotion needs a single cross-phase lifecycle map.
Source identity normalization, rights basis, content interpretation, schema validation, and retrieval projection owners remain unbound.
Semantic relation, graph, RDF/SHACL, and Olog contracts remain deferred until a simpler model fails a concrete positive/negative witness.
design_consequences: Research must produce a phase-labelled contract catalogue instead of another broad architecture narrative.

Every proposed contract row must name producer, consumer, bound inputs and outputs, invariant, failure diagnostic, authority effect, version or compatibility owner, current status, and smallest positive and negative witness.
Phase-0 content and projection contracts must remain separate from Phase-1 GitHub and agent contribution controls and from later semantic or ontology admission.
The public Design delta must cite public target artifacts or primary external sources; private Inventory paths may guide research but must not appear in the public repository.
Olog remains an evaluated later substrate whose admission requires repeated total functional arrows, path equations, mapping need, an owner, and a witness that the simpler contract cannot preserve.
residue: The target repository has no repository-local Inventory package; the private parent Inventory is only an upstream discovery read model.
Inventory matches do not prove precedent, correctness, current implementation, owner binding, or Design admission.
The four raw governance artifacts already untracked in the public target remain outside publication scope.
No new contract, implementation, schema, skill, GitHub control, ontology edge, or authority state is authorized by this lookup.
non_authority_notice: This packet is a read-only discovery aid. It cannot authorize dispatch, satisfy check-tension, replace source verification, bind owners, mutate the Akashic Design, or promote any contract.
